2160.title: Pi keeps using previous model after model picker change until /compact
2160.rootCauseOneLine: #1640 replaced the runtime's option-drift 'session' classification with 'live' for the Pi and ACP adapters, and neither bridge reads params.options on turn/start; the ACP bridge applies the model only at session construction (a --model launch flag for Cursor/Grok Build), so a picker change after the first turn is silently dropped until the session is rebuilt.
2160.proposedFix: On turn/start and turn/steer compare params.options with the session's pinned selection: native-selection agents apply set_model/set_config_option in place; CLI-flag agents (Cursor, Grok Build) rebuild the session with new launch args and emit session/replaced. Or restore a 'session' classification at the adapter level for bridges without per-turn reconciliation, which fixes Pi and ACP together.
2160.caveats: Reproduced on acp-cursor (two independent fresh instances); the Pi case from the issue was traced in code, not re-run. Steer path shares the code shape but was not run live. The user's original report (screenshot) described it as a Claude-to-Cursor provider switch; that reading is refuted in the report.
